sections.Profile:
Gold Ball , released by Bally in 1983, is a four-player solid-state game designed by George Christian with artwork by Tony Ramunni. Alongside the usual silver ball it carries a gold-colored one, which the game releases at random as an extra ball and which triples all playfield scores while it is in play; 1,750 were built.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1983
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
